verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API keys can be created self-serve in the console, and a Management API can manage teams. Neither mentions limiting a key to particular endpoints, models, or permissions for least-privilege agent use. Ephemeral tokens exist, but they are documented only as short-lived client-side auth for the Speech to Speech API, an adjacent feature rather than scoped agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
